head: 0d0f516ebe041a7a2bb2f9b20020584b4345e839
scope: 14 changed files; ending renderer, B1 stamp, live hash previews, pronunciation test fixture, docs; unchanged vocabulary checked for integrity, not re-read semantically

findings.title: Keep drone text within the available viewport sky
findings.trigger: Full ending step 5 at 320x568 or 844x390; wait until BIG MOUNTAIN drone shape settles
findings.observed: Forcing skyBox to at least 90px overwrites the top viewport clamp. At 320x568, 169/650 drone centers are above the viewport and BIG disappears. At 844x390, 526/650 centers are above it.
findings.expected: Narrative drone text remains readable inside the viewport; intentional offscreen fireworks do not justify clipped letters.
findings.recommendation: Fit the drone shape to actual available sky or coordinate stage sizing. Keep the viewport top bound after applying minimum/preferred dimensions and dialogue layout changes.

findings.title: Restore source-over outside the glow comment before drawing letters
findings.trigger: Full ending first highlighted reading message
findings.observed: The source-over assignment is part of the trailing // comment. Both strokeText and fillText run with lighter. Intended #9b85f2 adds to the glow and becomes nearly white; the dark outline no longer masks the light as intended.
findings.expected: Glow is additive, but the word retains its final set color and dark masking outline per the accepted design.
findings.recommendation: Move the composite reset into executable code after the glow and before the text. Preserve the approved glow design.
findings.proof_limit: The source-over comparison only changes the review browser's in-memory drawing calls, not the application files.

findings.title: Protect an active timed question when opening a live hash preview
findings.trigger: While a question is running, add #ending=b1 to the same page URL and wait beyond its remaining time
findings.observed: The ending covers the question but the ticker remains active. errors goes 0 to 1 and remaining 15 to 0. After close the original card reports timeout. Stamp and milestone previews also leave the timer running. Baseline live hash changes do not open these overlays.
findings.expected: Reviewing an effect should not turn a hidden question into an incorrect answer.
findings.recommendation: Defer live previews until outside gameplay or suspend and restore question time/input. Guard delayed callbacks and coalesce repeated preview requests.
findings.scope_limit: Preview-only path; normal B1/full completion has no active ticker. Permanent progress corruption was not established.

findings.title: Honor reduced motion for the new B1 stamping animation
findings.trigger: Enable prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, open B1 ending and advance to the final stamp
findings.observed: JS fireworks and flying words are skipped, but the newly added festamp CSS animation still applies 1.9x scale, translation, and rotation for 0.55 seconds.
findings.expected: The new animation respects the motion preference while the completed stamp remains visible.
findings.recommendation: Disable festamp in the reduced-motion media query and explicitly apply final opacity/transform/filter. Check the existing parent endpop at the same time; animation:none alone leaves default st-ink opacity zero.

verification.real_browser: Installed Chrome on Windows, fresh profiles; normal B1/full completion, real-time full ending, three-course pronunciation, stamp pronunciation
